description: This PHP class defines server-side system methods for Zend's XML-RPC implementation, including listing methods, providing method help and signatures, and handling multicall requests.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_System
classes.description: Provides system-related XML-RPC methods such as listing methods, getting method help and signatures, and multicall support.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of all available XML-RPC method names.

methods.name: methodHelp
methods.description: Displays help information for a specified XML-RPC method.

methods.name: methodSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of a specified XML-RPC method.

methods.name: multicall
methods.description: Handles multiple XML-RPC method calls within a single request, supporting batch processing and error handling.
